name: Claude Security
desc: Claude that scans codebases for vulnerabilities and proposes fixes
desc_zh: 扫描代码库漏洞并给出修复建议的 Claude 安全产品
solves: Pattern-matching scanners drown teams in alerts; Claude Security traces data flows and verifies each finding first.
solves_zh: 规则扫描器带来大量误报，Claude Security 先追踪数据流并逐条验证漏洞。
best_for: A monorepo has never had a security review and the pen test is booked for next month.
best_for_zh: 代码库从没做过安全评审，而渗透测试下个月就要开始。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 Outside the window. Public beta for Claude Enterprise customers. 首次公开日期来源：https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-security-public-beta
